product.product_description:
🌿 Forest Moss

Musk • Sandalwood

A deep, earthy artisan soap with the warm richness of musk and sandalwood. Handcrafted using nourishing natural oils, butters and botanical ingredients, its earthy green tone comes naturally from mineral-rich clays and botanicals. A sophisticated, grounding bathing ritual with a rich fragrance.

❤️ Crimson Dusk

Lavender

A beautifully aromatic lavender soap crafted with natural oils, nourishing butters and thoughtfully selected botanical ingredients. Its deep crimson hue is created using natural clays and botanicals. Richly fragranced, calming and elegant—perfect for an indulgent evening ritual.

💗 Blushing Hearts

Spring Moon

A delicate, romantic artisan soap with a soft floral fragrance inspired by Spring Moon. Made with natural oils, butters and botanical ingredients, its beautiful blush tones come from naturally derived clays and botanicals. A gentle-looking luxury with a rich, lingering fragrance.

🌸 Blush & Bloom

Attract Money

A vibrant floral artisan soap created for those who love a little colour and character in their daily ritual. Crafted with natural oils, nourishing butters, clays and botanical ingredients, its beautiful blush tones are naturally derived. Finished with a rich, captivating fragrance.

🍑 Peach Veil

J&J

Soft, creamy and wonderfully nostalgic, Peach Veil brings a comforting powdery fragrance to your everyday bathing ritual. Handcrafted with natural oils, butters and botanical ingredients, its delicate peach tone comes naturally from clays and botanicals. Richly fragranced and beautifully indulgent.

🌙 Twilight Moon

Spring Moon

Inspired by the quiet beauty of twilight, this artisan soap carries a soft, fresh floral fragrance with an elegant character. Handcrafted with natural oils, butters, clays and botanical ingredients, its natural tones are created without relying on artificial colours. A dreamy, richly fragranced bathing experience.

💙 Azure Mist

Lavender • Lemon

A refreshing blend of bright lemon and soothing lavender, Azure Mist brings a fresh, uplifting character to your bathing ritual. Made with nourishing natural oils, butters, clays and botanical ingredients, its beautiful blue-grey tones are naturally derived. Fresh, aromatic and richly fragranced.

✨ Golden Aura

Ubtan

Inspired by the timeless Indian ubtan ritual, Golden Aura is a warm, earthy artisan soap crafted with natural oils, butters, clays and botanical ingredients. Its golden colour comes naturally from turmeric and other botanicals. Richly fragranced, warm and rooted in traditional Indian beauty rituals.

🌹 Rose Noir

Rose

A luxurious take on the timeless rose, Rose Noir combines an elegant floral fragrance with the richness of handcrafted soapmaking. Made with natural oils, butters, clays and botanical ingredients, its naturally beautiful colour comes from mineral clays and botanicals. Richly fragranced, romantic and indulgent.
